objective: Audit recent activation history and frontier decisions to determine whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection produces better information flow.
bottleneck: Prior activations had durable conclusions but task choice was opportunistic from a queue.
question: Does the current focused-task selector improve learning efficiency relative to the repository's prior opportunistic task choice?
action: Audited the campaign selector implementation, the current task queue and campaign status, LEARNING_STATE.md, STATE.md, activation_status.json, and the 2026-10-05/06 activation logs; hand-computed the selector's ordinal ranking for the six OPEN LEARNING_PROCESS tasks and compared it with the recorded contract.selection_basis.compared_against; traced the only resolved campaign-queue task (R-004) to its frontier-first selection in the 2026-10-06 activation log.
verified: Inspected .github/scripts/campaign_controller.py:198-225: task_rank is a deterministic ordinal tuple (expected_information_gain, downstream_leverage, falsification_power, verifiability, effort, complexity, execution_risk, task_id); candidate_tasks_for_role filters to role + status OPEN and sorts by that key; select_task picks candidates[0] (lines 269-383).

Hand-computed the ranking for P-001..P-006: the top five are P-001, P-002, P-004, P-003, P-006, which exactly matches agent_01_contract.json selection_basis.compared_against. P-001 is also first in task_queue.json order, so this selection coincides with opportunistic queue order.

Inspected state/LEARNING_STATE.md: the frontier-first delta is RETAIN (verified) across five new-signal-class frontier cells (mean-reversion FALSIFIED 37263008074; cross-sectional relative strength FALSIFIED 37304873966; volatility targeting FALSIFIED 37314710995; momentum SUPPORTED 37318950814; 20-day breakout FALSIFIED 37414038601) plus the longer-horizon momentum qualification (37394344201), with no equivalent re-tests recorded.

Inspected state/activation_status.json and logs/ACTIVATION-2026-10-06.md: the only resolved campaign-queue task R-004 records 'Selection basis: frontier-first', not the campaign selector's ordinal ranking; the selector's top-ranked OPEN research task is R-001.

Inspected state/campaign/task_queue.json and state/campaign/runs/43776172539/campaign_status.json: six LEARNING_PROCESS tasks P-001..P-006 are OPEN, R-004 is RESOLVED, and campaign status shows one selection (agent 1 -> P-001) with completed_agents empty.
unverified: No counterfactual or completed campaign task attributable to the campaign selector exists: only agent 1 has run in this campaign (completed_agents is empty), so a comparative learning-efficiency gain over opportunistic choice is not demonstrated.
The selector's ordinal ranking was verified by code inspection and hand computation, not by executing the controller (bash is denied at this layer); no command-line test was run.
No independent UTC clock was available (bash/date denied); activation start is anchored to the environment message time 2026-11-15T23:48:25Z and the finish time is unobserved.
Whether the frontier-first practice would have produced the same selection without the campaign selector cannot be separated from the selector's effect using the durable records.
observed_effect: Observed at 2026-11-15T23:48:25Z (environment message time). The selector is explicit, deterministic, role-aware, and auditable, and its recorded compared_against exactly matches the computed ordinal ranking. However, the selected task P-001 is also first in queue order, and the only completed campaign-queue task (R-004) was frontier-selected rather than selector-selected. The frontier-first practice has a verified record of five new-signal-class cells closed decisively with no equivalent re-tests, but the campaign selector itself has not yet produced a completed, attributable outcome. No learning-efficiency advantage over opportunistic choice is demonstrated; the selector is structurally sound and low-risk.
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection produces better information flow than the repository's prior opportunistic queue-based task choice.
uncertainty_reduced: Partial. Verified that the selector is explicit, deterministic, role-aware, and its recorded ranking matches the computed order; verified the frontier-first practice's decisive cells with no equivalent re-tests. Did not establish a comparative learning-efficiency gain: the selected task coincides with queue order and no completed campaign task is attributable to the selector.
research_result: No new market research; process audit only. Durable qualification: the campaign selector's superiority over opportunistic task choice is not demonstrated by current evidence; the verified frontier-first practice remains the operative selection improvement.
next: After at least two more campaign tasks complete, re-audit campaign selection_history to test whether any selector-driven selection diverges from queue order and produces a decisive, non-duplicative outcome.

candidate_tasks.objective: Re-audit campaign selection_history and task_queue after at least two more campaign tasks complete, comparing selector choices against queue order and recording whether each selected task closed decisively without an equivalent re-test.
candidate_tasks.scope: Use state/campaign/runs/*/campaign_status.json, task_queue.json, and agent records only; no new experiments and no controller changes.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not modify .github/scripts/**, workflows, or protected files; do not add a numerical reward score; do not rerun historical experiments.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A follow-up process decision classifying whether the selector produced a divergent, decisive, non-duplicative selection.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: At least two campaign task outcomes are compared with queue order and the selector's comparative effect is classified as improved, unchanged, worsened, or unverified.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop once the available campaign outcomes are classified or the evidence is insufficient.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Controller-side inspection of selection_history, task_queue, and agent records; no reliance on agent confidence.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: P-001 audit found no completed selector-attributable outcome and no divergent selection; more campaign outcomes are needed.
